name: 3D FEA (parametric parts)
description: Linear elastic 3D FEA of a parametric OpenPara part, or of an assembly: the parts are fully bonded where they touch (each with its own material), or joined by SCREWS and BOLTS - the faces between two parts are cut into patches, the same screw is put on as many patches as you select, the parts touch with frictionless contact everywhere else, and the force through each patch is checked with AISI S100-16 Chapter J (the equations of the Sheets add-on, which this uses when it is installed). Pick faces for supports (fixed, one direction, bolt hole) and loads (force, pressure, force at a vertex, gravity), quadratic tetrahedra from gmsh, von Mises, displacement and safety factor, animation. An Adaptive mesh (h) option refines the mesh where the estimated error is large and solves again until a chosen result (von Mises, displacement or strain energy) settles within a tolerance (single parts and bonded assemblies, tetrahedra). A .gpv project folder with its own copy of the part; works with Parametric Studies (single parts).
